scenario: Identity slot resolution per LSER.7.6.1 / LFAC.1.7. When `by:` is omitted, a `logical` schema defaults the series grouping to its declared identity `key` slots. Pin: Reading{device key, state mutable} with no `by:` resolves grouping to `device` and compiles — no DS_VALIDATE_SERIES_NO_IDENTITY_SLOT, since the schema declares a key.
rules_ds:
schema Reading scope logical:
    device: String key
    state: Float mutable

series Reading.state:
    mean sliding 10_min
